args.query: Typer CLI with subcommands printing a Rich table and a progress bar

results.title: Typer CLI with rich Progress and Table for batch jobs
results.summary: A Typer command that squares a batch of numbers behind a rich Progress bar and prints a rich Table summary, tested offline through typer's CliRunner.

results.title: Typer CLI with Rich tables, progress and --json output
results.summary: A Typer command that renders Rich tables and progress on stderr, with a --json mode for piping, tested offline with CliRunner and no-color Rich output.

results.title: Typer CLI exporting Rich tables and CSV for batch reports
results.summary: A Typer command that aggregates a batch of CSV reports, renders a Rich table with escaped cells and formatted totals, and exports a machine-parseable CSV, tested offline with CliRunner.

results.title: Click CLI with rich Progress bars and Status for batch work
results.summary: A Click command normalizes a batch while rich draws a Progress bar and a Status spinner, with tests that pin down terminal detection, transient output and ANSI stripping.

results.title: Typer CLI with subcommands, options and CliRunner tests
results.summary: Build a Typer CLI with subcommands, typed options, env var fallbacks and exit codes, tested with typer.testing.CliRunner.

results.title: Cyclopts CLI with Annotated types and rich help
results.summary: A typed Cyclopts command using Annotated Parameter help text and enum/int/list coercion, invoked offline in tests with captured stdout, stderr and return values.

results.title: TanStack Table core sorting, filtering and pagination
results.summary: Use @tanstack/table-core headlessly to sort, filter and paginate row models without React, asserting filtered and page rows in plain Node tests.

results.title: Commander CLI with Zod option validation, tested in-process
results.summary: A Commander subcommand CLI with variadic arguments, repeatable options, choices and Zod-backed argument parsers, made testable with exitOverride and configureOutput so node:test runs it in-process without spawning.

results.title: clipanion typed CLI parser
results.summary: Define a clipanion Cli with two commands using Option.String/Option.Boolean, then drive it in tests via Cli.run with captured stdout/stderr to assert help text and exit codes without process.exit.

results.title: Click CLI for RRULE next run times, tested with freezegun and CliRunner
results.summary: A Click command that computes the next run times of an RFC 5545 rule in any IANA zone with dateutil rrule and zoneinfo, with DST gaps normalized and time frozen with freezegun in tests.
